does_not_cover: Maximum likelihood estimation is only pointed at, never derived or computed; no estimator appears.
No CLT, no standardization, no distribution fitting; the normal curve is a prop, not an object of study.
notes: Very brisk; mouse-weight example carries the whole video. Assumes comfort with normal curves and area-as-probability; no notation clashes.

segments.topic: Setup: a fixed normal curve of mouse weights
Probability as area under the fixed curve, 29% example
Likelihood as curve height at fixed data, 0.12 vs 0.21
Summary contrast: probability of data vs likelihood of a distribution

teaches.why: Works the fixed-distribution vs fixed-data distinction twice with numbers.
